title: Support triage
description: Route a support message to a team, rate the frustration and flag urgency: one question of each type.

department.instructions: Which team should handle this message?

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, refunds and payment methods
criteria.technical: Bugs, errors, outages and how the product works
criteria.sales: Pricing, plans, upgrades and buying more

is_urgent.instructions: The message needs an answer today: something is broken, blocked or about to cost money.

examples.name: Double charge
examples.state: Hi, I was charged twice for my March invoice (INV-2291). Could you refund one of the payments? Thanks!

examples.name: Outage
examples.state: Our whole team has been locked out since this morning and the dashboard only shows error 502. We have a client demo in two hours. This is the third time this month.

examples.name: Upgrade question
examples.state: We're a team of 12 thinking of moving from Starter to Business. Is single sign-on included, and is there a discount for paying yearly?

examples.name: Lost access
examples.state: I changed phones and my authenticator codes no longer work, so I can't sign in. How do I reset two-factor?
